metadata.title: Clicked like I owed the enemy a soda and somehow snagged that 1 clueless kill? Valorant logic off...
metadata.description:
Spam clicked like my mouse was confused but it worked somehow.
Enemy probably booting up the uninstall menu.
Pretending I meant that for 0.12 seconds before laughing it off.
Click if your aim is a happy accident magnet!

Tap if your aim’s a beautiful disaster but kills still happen!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
